# Original Sed witness

Complete 8893-byte `mario.sed` from https://github.com/chebykinn/sedmario,
revision `4bca8b0118249941d51b91ac28ddb3913f5a34b0`. SHA256:
`310f1baf0e0925a6dd23af1cd1806ef1fc004b159d019b77f3d0f5d6f4aac05f`.
The complete upstream MIT license is retained: Copyright (c) 2015 Ivan.

Raw CRLF bytes remain exact. The declared static parser view collapses only
paired CRLF and maps all published spans back to these physical bytes.
Native CST context is not proof of definitions, branch resolution, GNU raw
program interpretation or full language support. All six semantic obligations
and complete source retrieval remain mandatory for later producer admission.
